settings.label: Folder
settings.help: Where Claude Code starts; ~ is your home. Applies the next time it starts (the restart button).

settings.label: Command
settings.help: The command line that runs Claude Code, e.g. "claude --permission-mode auto". Applies the next time it starts.

settings.label: Stop when idle
settings.help: Closed and not working this long, Claude Code stops; the next time the notch opens, a new one starts (/resume brings the conversation back). 0 keeps it running.

settings.label: Font
settings.help: A monospace font family for the terminal; empty uses the theme's. Applies the next time it starts.
